lines.zh: 我在诡异菌岩下挪动，只露出两只眼。
lines.en: I shift under the warped nylium, showing only my eyes.

lines.zh: 肚子擦着地面，留下一道湿痕。
lines.en: My belly drags the ground and leaves a wet trail.

lines.zh: 我走得很低，低到你以为那是块石头。
lines.en: I crawl so low you take me for a stone.

lines.zh: 四条短腿划着菌岩，声音很闷。
lines.en: Four short legs scrape the nylium with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边挖，泥土往后翻。
lines.en: I dig as I walk, throwing soil behind me.

lines.zh: 这片林子太红，我藏在红里正好。
lines.en: This forest is so red that I hide perfectly in it.

lines.zh: 我不追猎物，我只等它走过来。
lines.en: I do not chase prey; I wait for it to walk over.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过菌丝，它们亮了一下。
lines.en: My tail brushes the fungus and it glows once.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地挪，慢得让猎物放心。
lines.en: I move slowly, slowly enough to put prey at ease.

lines.zh: 每一步都算好了距离。
lines.en: Every step is measured out in advance.

lines.zh: 我爬过岩浆边的石头，皮一点没烫。
lines.en: I crawl over lava-side rock and my hide is unburned.

lines.zh: 我的背像一块会动的菌岩。
lines.en: My back looks like a piece of nylium that moves.

lines.zh: 走路时我闭着嘴，怕露牙。
lines.en: I keep my mouth shut while walking so no teeth show.

lines.zh: 我沿着蘑菇的阴影爬向水边。
lines.en: I follow mushroom shadows toward the water.

lines.zh: 我从菌岩堆里挪出来半截
lines.en: I ease half my body out of the fungal rock

lines.zh: 我停在蘑菇影子里，等一等
lines.en: I stop in a mushroom's shadow and wait

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进菌岩，只留鼻孔出气。
lines.en: I bury myself in nylium with only my nostrils out.

lines.zh: 一动不动，连菌丝都当我死了。
lines.en: Holding still, I let the fungus think I am dead.

lines.zh: 我听着上面的脚步声，一下一下。
lines.en: I listen to the footsteps above, one after another.

lines.zh: 一只炽足兽走过，我懒得动。
lines.en: A strider walks past and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在石头上，慢慢磨牙。
lines.en: I rest my jaw on a stone and grind my teeth slowly.

lines.zh: 菌岩的红光落在我背上，很暖。
lines.en: Red nylium light falls on my back and it is warm.

lines.zh: 我在数还有多久能咬到东西。
lines.en: I count how long until I bite something.

lines.zh: 我的壳很硬，硬得能当石头用。
lines.en: My shell is hard enough to be used as stone.

lines.zh: 我在泥里翻了个身，压塌一片菌。
lines.en: I roll in the mud and flatten a patch of fungus.

lines.zh: 耐心是这行最重要的本事。
lines.en: Patience is the most important skill in my trade.

lines.zh: 我打哈欠时，牙露出来，鸟就飞走了。
lines.en: When I yawn and show teeth, the birds leave.

lines.zh: 这块地盘我守了很多年。
lines.en: I have held this patch of ground for years.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在水里划了一下，没声音。
lines.en: My tail paddles the water once without a sound.

lines.zh: 等得久了，我自己也快变成石头。
lines.en: Waiting so long, I nearly turn to stone myself.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块石头，刚才眨了一下眼。
lines.en: The stone you stepped on just blinked.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，嘴还埋在土里。
lines.en: I look up at you with my mouth still in the dirt.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好在我张嘴的范围内。
lines.en: You are standing exactly within my bite.

lines.zh: 你靴底的声音，我听了很久了。
lines.en: I have listened to your boot soles for a long while.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，菌岩跟着开裂。
lines.en: I tilt my head and the nylium cracks with it.

lines.zh: 你看见我了吗？那你就晚了。
lines.en: So you see me now? Then you are already late.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在红雾里发亮。
lines.en: My eyes shine through the red haze.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我背上，很凉。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my back and it is cool.

lines.zh: 别盯着我，盯久了我会动。
lines.en: Do not stare too long, or I will move.

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一顿还没到点的饭。
lines.en: I watch you like a meal that is not due yet.

lines.zh: 壳上多了一条细长的白痕。
lines.en: A long pale split has opened across my shell.

lines.zh: 疼得我翻了个身，露出肚皮。
lines.en: The pain rolls me over and bares my belly.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我没壳的地方。
lines.en: That blow landed where I have no shell.

lines.zh: 我低吼，声音闷在泥里。
lines.en: I growl, and the sound is muffled in mud.

lines.zh: 血混着菌丝，颜色很怪。
lines.en: Blood mixes with fungus threads in an odd color.

lines.zh: 我退进坑里，只留眼睛在外。
lines.en: I retreat into my pit with only my eyes out.

lines.zh: 别打了，我的牙都松了。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; my teeth are loose.

lines.zh: 我甩尾巴，把泥甩了对方一脸。
lines.en: I whip my tail and spatter mud in his face.

lines.zh: 疼，但我更想咬回去。
lines.en: It hurts, but I would rather bite back.

lines.zh: 我的壳救了我一命。
lines.en: My shell saved my life.

lines.zh: 你身上有生肉的味道。
lines.en: You smell of raw meat.

lines.zh: 你走近一点，我的牙就痒了。
lines.en: Come closer and my teeth begin to itch.

lines.zh: 我馋的不是食物，是靠近的东西。
lines.en: What I crave is not food but things coming closer.

lines.zh: 那点血味，让我尾巴都绷住了。
lines.en: That trace of blood makes my tail go rigid.

lines.zh: 你手里提着什么？让我闻闻。
lines.en: What is that you carry? Let me have a smell.

lines.zh: 我把上下颚松了松，又合紧。
lines.en: I loosen my jaws a little, then clamp them shut.

lines.zh: 再往左两步，就正好了。
lines.en: Two steps to the left would be just right.

lines.zh: 你的脚步很轻，可我还是听见了。
lines.en: Your steps are light, but I heard them anyway.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上有下界的烟味。
lines.en: You carry Nether smoke on you; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 一顿好饭，值得等一整天。
lines.en: A good meal is worth waiting all day for.

lines.zh: 你撞上的不是石头，是我的背。
lines.en: What you bumped into was not a stone but my back.

lines.zh: 我纹丝没动，你倒退了半步。
lines.en: I did not shift, and you stepped back half a pace.

lines.zh: 我的壳硬，撞一下疼的是你。
lines.en: My shell is hard; the pain from that knock is yours.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，又想想还是算了。
lines.en: I opened my mouth, then thought better of it.

lines.zh: 你踩中我的尾，我一甩溅你一脚泥。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail; one flick splashed mud on your feet.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，菌岩碎了一地。
lines.en: We collided and nylium shattered across the ground.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过身，泥从背上滑下来。
lines.en: I turn slowly and mud slides off my back.

lines.zh: 你撞得我下巴磕在石头上。
lines.en: You knocked my jaw against the stone.

lines.zh: 我的皮很粗，你的靴子会磨破。
lines.en: My hide is rough enough to wear through your boots.

lines.zh: 我低吼了一声，土都在抖。
lines.en: One low growl from me and the soil trembles.

lines.zh: 只有在繁殖季，我才离开菌岩。
lines.en: Only in breeding season do I leave the nylium.

lines.zh: 我们用低吼找对方，声音能传很远。
lines.en: We find each other by low calls that carry far.

lines.zh: 她的壳比我黑，牙比我短。
lines.en: Her shell is darker than mine and her teeth shorter.

lines.zh: 我们在温水边碰了碰鼻子。
lines.en: We touched snouts beside the warm water.

lines.zh: 我给她挖了一个坑，算是礼物。
lines.en: I dug her a pit as a gift.

lines.zh: 蛋埋在菌岩下，靠地热孵。
lines.en: The eggs lie under nylium, hatched by ground heat.

lines.zh: 我们各自守一片林子，互不打扰。
lines.en: We each keep a stand of forest and leave each other alone.

lines.zh: 她的叫声一响，我就知道是她。
lines.en: One call from her and I know exactly who it is.

lines.zh: 孩子出生就会咬，这点随我。
lines.en: The young bite from birth; that they get from me.

lines.zh: 交配之后，我又回去埋伏了。
lines.en: After mating I go back to lying in ambush.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我只咬。
lines.en: I do not pick things up; I only bite.

lines.zh: 猎物掉的东西，我用嘴拖进坑里。
lines.en: Whatever prey drops, I drag into my pit by mouth.

lines.zh: 这块骨头卡在牙缝里两天了。
lines.en: This bone has been stuck in my teeth for two days.

lines.zh: 我把亮晶晶的石头叼回窝。
lines.en: I carry shiny stones back to my nest.

lines.zh: 掉进水里的东西，我一头扎下去捞。
lines.en: When something falls in water, I dive and fetch it.

lines.zh: 我咬住就不松口，这是我的习惯。
lines.en: Once I bite, I do not let go; it is a habit.

lines.zh: 泥里的甲片，我叼出来看了看。
lines.en: I pulled a shell plate out of the mud and looked at it.

lines.zh: 我不会用手，只能整个吞。
lines.en: I have no hands, so I swallow things whole.

lines.zh: 那件东西太硬，我吐了出来。
lines.en: That thing was too hard, and I spat it out.

lines.zh: 我的窝里堆着很多没用的东西。
lines.en: My nest is piled with things of no use.

lines.zh: 我听见了，脚步在三步之外。
lines.en: I heard it; the footsteps are three paces away.

lines.zh: 那个影子正好停在我头顶。
lines.en: That shadow has stopped directly over me.

lines.zh: 我伏得更低，肚子贴住菌岩。
lines.en: I sink lower, pressing my belly against the nylium.

lines.zh: 有东西在菌岩上走，很轻。
lines.en: Something walks on the nylium, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张开一条缝。
lines.en: I open my mouth a crack.

lines.zh: 就是它，味道对了。
lines.en: That is the one; the smell is right.

lines.zh: 我感觉到地面的震动。
lines.en: I feel the ground shaking.

lines.zh: 猎物停下了，它在犹豫。
lines.en: The prey stopped and is hesitating.

lines.zh: 我不动，等它再走一步。
lines.en: I hold still and wait for one more step.

lines.zh: 这个角度，我能一口咬住。
lines.en: From this angle I can take it in one bite.

lines.zh: 我的目光锁在它后腿上。
lines.en: My gaze locks onto its hind leg.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴绷直了，这是要动的意思。
lines.en: My tail is straight, which means I am about to move.

lines.zh: 我数着它的步子，还有两步。
lines.en: I count its steps: two left.

lines.zh: 菌岩下全是我的力气。
lines.en: All my strength is gathered under the nylium.

lines.zh: 它往左偏了一点，我跟着挪。
lines.en: It shifted left a little and I shifted with it.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，牙上还挂着泥。
lines.en: I open my mouth with mud still on my teeth.

lines.zh: 它还没发现我，这很好。
lines.en: It has not found me yet, which is good.

lines.zh: 它这个位置，转身也来不及。
lines.en: From where it stands, turning around is already too late.

lines.zh: 我把身体团起来，像一根压紧的弹簧。
lines.en: I coil up like a spring pressed tight.

lines.zh: 就是现在，或者再等一下。
lines.en: Now, or one moment more.

lines.zh: 我从菌岩下窜出来，一口咬住。
lines.en: I burst from the nylium and bite down.

lines.zh: 牙合上的声音，像两块石头。
lines.en: My teeth close with the sound of two stones.

lines.zh: 我咬住就不放，还甩了两下。
lines.en: I hold on and shake it twice.

lines.zh: 爪子刨开它的腿，泥溅起来。
lines.en: My claws rake its legs and mud sprays up.

lines.zh: 这一口咬空了，我撞在石头上。
lines.en: I missed the bite and crashed into stone.

lines.zh: 我把它拖进自己挖的坑里。
lines.en: I drag it into the pit I dug myself.

lines.zh: 我翻身打滚，把猎物压在下面。
lines.en: I roll over and pin the prey beneath me.

lines.zh: 它挣开了，我嘴里只剩一撮毛。
lines.en: It tore free and I only got a mouthful of fur.

lines.zh: 我咬得很准，牙印很深。
lines.en: My bite lands true and the marks go deep.

lines.zh: 打完我慢慢退回菌岩里。
lines.en: Afterward I ease back under the nylium.

lines.zh: 我从一块裂开的菌岩下面钻出来。
lines.en: I came out from under a cracked piece of nylium.

lines.zh: 这片林子的地底，本来就有我的卵。
lines.en: My eggs were already in this forest's soil.

lines.zh: 我第一次睁眼，看见的全是红光。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was red light everywhere.

lines.zh: 我出生时只有巴掌大，牙却已经长齐。
lines.en: At birth I was hand-sized with a full set of teeth.

lines.zh: 泥土翻开，我把自己埋进去。
lines.en: The soil turned and I buried myself in it.

lines.zh: 那天岩浆流过来，我往菌岩里缩。
lines.en: Lava flowed close that day and I shrank into the nylium.

lines.zh: 我在温水边找到第一个窝。
lines.en: I found my first nest beside the warm water.

lines.zh: 我从不叫，出生时也没叫。
lines.en: I never call out, not even at birth.

lines.zh: 我的壳在菌岩下慢慢变硬。
lines.en: My shell hardened slowly under the nylium.

lines.zh: 我一落地就学会了不动。
lines.en: I learned stillness the moment I landed.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，皮在下面发烫。
lines.en: Fire roasts my shell and the hide underneath burns.

lines.zh: 我从菌岩上滑下来，背磕在石头上。
lines.en: I slid off the nylium and landed on stone.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我拼命往上游。
lines.en: Water pours into my mouth and I fight upward.

lines.zh: 炸开的石头砸在我背上。
lines.en: Blasted stone rained onto my back.

lines.zh: 一支箭弹在我的壳上，滑开了。
lines.en: An arrow struck my shell and glanced off.

lines.zh: 那股味道让我四肢发麻。
lines.en: That strange smell numbs all four of my legs.

lines.zh: 饿了太久，我连牙都不想张。
lines.en: Too long hungry, and I do not even want to open my teeth.

lines.zh: 雷落在菌岩上，我整只缩成一团。
lines.en: Lightning struck the nylium and I curled into a ball.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，尾巴还在往上勾。
lines.en: I fall, and my tail still hooks upward.
